To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
MGMT promoter hyper‐methylation is a frequent and important mechanism in oligodendrogial tumor development.

MGMT promoter hypermethylations and low or absent protein expression is common in oligodendrogial tumors, and that these events are associated with loss of heterozigosity on the chromosomes arms 1p/19q.
